entities.name: Pedro de Ursúa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro de Ursúa was a Spanish conquistador from Baztan in Navarre. He is best known for his final trip with Lope de Aguirre in search for El Dorado, where he was assassinated in a plot by a fellow officer.
